prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create ONE 1024 x 1024 transparent RGBA texture-source painting, LEFT orthographic view.
Inputs in order: (1) guide_left.png is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry/alpha/framing authority; (2) design_reference.png is MATERIAL AND COLOUR REFERENCE ONLY; (3) concept_crop.png is supporting original design reference.
Paint directly over input 1. Preserve its EXACT pixel silhouette, scale, position, orthographic camera, every shape edge, opening, overlapping part, debris polygon and transparent gap. Preserve the guide alpha boundary. Do not reconstruct the shape from the design reference; do not use its three-quarter camera. Guide has tail fin upper left, circular assembly left of centre, nose facing right. Keep all guide geometry unchanged, including the large central side panel.
Apply chipped off-white ceramic panels with thin gold seams and rivets, dull gold/brass borders, dark tinted glass in existing glass areas, dark grey machinery, rust on existing landing legs, and warm amber lamplight colour only within any existing doorway/interior opening. Preserve all existing rubble and parts within guide silhouette; add no new objects or floor.
This is unlit ALBEDO for texture projection, not a beauty render. Flat, even, shadowless viewer illumination: no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional shading, no specular shine or reflections, no rim lighting. White ceramic stays off-white across surfaces, brass is matte ochre gold, glass is flat dark tinted charcoal. Glowing parts are painted their warm colour without lighting nearby surfaces. Match reference material colours and wear, not reference lighting. No background, no floor, no text. Return native 1024 x 1024, transparent background, unchanged framing, no resizing/cropping.
reason: Not selected: incorrect native dimensions, invented or altered geometry and excessive shading.

checks.materials_and_colours: White ceramic, gold trim and dark machinery broadly match; warm doorway colour not reliably retained in corrective returns.
checks.flat_even_light: Fail: residual shading and highlights remain.
